question: [{(1690 - 934) × 5over6 + 815} ÷ 17] equals:
solution:
**Given:**

[{(1690 - 934) × 5over6 + 815} ÷ 17] 

**Concept used:**

Order of precedence in the BODMAS rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

**Calculation:**

= [{__**(1690 - 934)**__ × 5over6 + 815} ÷ 17]

= [__**{756 × 5over6**__** **+ 815} ÷ 17]

= [__**{630 + 815}**__ ÷ 17]

= [__**1445 ÷ 17**__]

= 85

Hence, the correct answer is **85.**
